## Red2PR `v0.1.0-beta.1` (Early-Access Beta)

Red2PR is a self-hosted CI repair platform licensed under **[Apache-2.0](https://github.com/nguywnben/red2pr/blob/v0.1.0-beta.1/LICENSE)** that pairs **Meta Muse** reasoning (`meta/muse-spark-1.3`, `meta/muse-wonder-1.0`) with **isolated sandbox reproduction, deterministic `V-01`–`V-08` verification gates, repository policy enforcement, and human-reviewed Draft Pull Requests / Merge Requests**—never auto-merging.

> **Pre-Release Notice:** `v0.1.0-beta.1` is an early-access / hackathon beta release covering implemented units `U01`–`U30` and the complete 21-screen React 19 + Meta Astryx web console. Wave 6 (`U31`–`U36`: multi-OS isolation host certification, benchmark calibration, Chaos/DR drills, offline HSM release-signing ceremony, and `P5` independent audit) is deferred to the `v1.0.0` track. Do not treat this pre-release as production-certified for untrusted multi-tenant workloads.

### Highlights
- **End-to-End Proof Pipeline (`V-01`–`V-08`):** Reproduces CI failures at `base_sha` (`Sandbox A` red), validates bounded candidate patches (`Sandbox B` green + broader suite + static checks + anti-test-weakening guard), signs an Ed25519 `EvidenceManifestV1` (`locally_verified`), and reconciles remote CI checks (`V-08`) on the exact pushed commit SHA.
- **Meta Muse Reasoning + Atomic USD Budgets (`ADR-051`):** Pre-inference secret redaction, per-repository outbound data-sharing consent, LiteLLM model-price catalog caching (`Decimal` ceiling conversion), and atomic per-session + daily workspace token reservation.
- **Repository Safety Modes & `SEC-031` Hazard Guardrails:** Per-repository `Monitor`, `Approval`, and `Auto-Repair` modes, versioned immutable policies, dry-run policy simulator, and automatic blocking of unsafe `pull_request_target` workflows.
- **Three-Zone Trust Architecture (`Z1` / `Z2` / `Z3`):** Compile-time `import-linter` boundaries, PostgreSQL 16 `FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY`, `AES-256-GCM` `SecretBroker` & artifact encryption, SHA-256 hash-chained audit logs, and zero-credential sandbox workers.
- **21-Screen Web Console & Multi-Surface Ops:** React 19 + TypeScript + Meta Astryx (`0.7.4`) Neutral UI (Light/Dark), TOTP MFA + fresh step-up confirmation, optional Telegram notifications with web-confirmed intents, MCP `2025-11-25` Streamable HTTP adapter (`ADR-050`), and unified `red2pr` CLI.

### Published Container Packages (GHCR)
Non-root (`10001:10001`), read-only-compatible container images built from this exact tag (`see container-images.txt` attached below for immutable `@sha256` digests):
- **Control Plane + Web Console (`Z1`/`Z2`):** `ghcr.io/nguywnben/red2pr-control:0.1.0-beta.1`
- **Isolated Worker Supervisor (`Z3`):** `ghcr.io/nguywnben/red2pr-worker:0.1.0-beta.1`

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/nguywnben/red2pr-control:0.1.0-beta.1
docker pull ghcr.io/nguywnben/red2pr-worker:0.1.0-beta.1
```

### Quick Start (From Source)

**Prerequisites:** Git, Python `3.12.x` + [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), Node.js `>= 22.12.0` + `pnpm` `9.15.x`.

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
git clone --branch v0.1.0-beta.1 https://github.com/nguywnben/red2pr.git
cd red2pr
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\quickstart.ps1
```

**Linux / macOS (Bash):**
```bash
git clone --branch v0.1.0-beta.1 https://github.com/nguywnben/red2pr.git
cd red2pr
./scripts/quickstart.sh
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:4280` using the printed one-use 15-minute `/setup#bootstrap_token=...` link to claim the instance owner account.
